rationale: A has a cohesive gold-on-midnight serif art direction and a quick, staggered hero entrance: the headline is already arriving at 250 ms and the phone mock follows it in. Its pinned 'one night, four hand-offs' sequence advances the clock and sleep graph from 11:40 to 2:55 to 6:10 as you scroll, and the page ends on a sunrise. B's purple aurora look with teal italic accents is just as rich and has more section variety, but its first viewport stays blank until about 850 ms. On mobile, B has visible collisions: a sticky card covers the 'Sound that responds' heading, and device chips overlap the 'Works with what you already own' text. A's phone layout is clean. Hover feedback is comparable: A uses underline reveals and a button lift, while B uses glow and brightening.
